_comment: Lightcone Commons rounds, written by scripts/fetch-lightcone-commons.ts from the public evaluator profiles at lightconecommons.com/profiles (the `funded` map embedded in each page) and the round summary on the homepage. Per-recipient totals are not published: each amount is the largest funded figure across the public profiles, and an Unknown Recipients row per round takes the rest of the round total. The funders are unnamed, so each grant is from Unknown Donors via Lightcone Commons. Hand mappings (recipient names, causes) live in the script.
